name: @federal-mcps/server-bls
description: MCP server for U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics data by place: LAUS, CES State & Area, QCEW, OEWS, CPI, JOLTS.

scripts.bundle: esbuild src/lambda.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=dist/lambda/lambda.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" && cd dist/lambda && python3 -m zipfile -c ../lambda.zip lambda.mjs
